The `codex exec --json` event vocabulary is in NO vendored schema — generate-json-schema describes app-server only — so this file is a fixture for the FALLBACK ADAPTER'S BEHAVIOUR, not a claim about what codex exec actually emits. It deliberately mixes lines shaped like app-server notifications (which the adapter maps) with lines that are not (which it must log by name and drop, rather than guess at). Replace it with a real `codex exec --json` capture on a machine that has Codex installed; ADAPTERS.md §8 tracks that.
